out-of-practice.instead: Say the word and we will name two firms who do this properly, with a note of what you have already told us so you are not starting again.

out-of-jurisdiction.instead: We work with firms in most places. We can make the introduction and send your brief across, or hold this until you tell us not to.

not-fixed-fee.body: A fixed fee only works when the shape of the job is knowable up front. Here it depends on things nobody can see yet, and a number invented now would be one of us absorbing the difference later.
not-fixed-fee.instead: Two options: a paid first read at a fixed price, which usually makes the rest quotable, or an hourly engagement with a cap you set.
